name: isabelle
title: Isabelle/HOL
summary: The Isabelle proof assistant with its HOL library, as a batch checker for theory files. The Archive of Formal Proofs is not included.

tools.name: isabelle-check
tools.does: checks one or more Isabelle theory files against Isabelle/HOL (they may import Main and each other). Exit code 0 and "Finished Check" mean every proof was accepted; a failed proof, or one that uses sorry, ends with "Unfinished session" and a non-zero exit code. Takes a few seconds to start
tools.check:
printf 'theory T imports Main begin
lemma "rev (rev xs) = xs" by simp
end
' > T.thy; isabelle-check T.thy 2>&1 | tail -4

tools.name: isabelle version
tools.does: which Isabelle release this pack holds; say it when you report that a proof was accepted
